subject: Migration findings live only in an ephemeral pane, with no durable record
description: Nancy, reviewing the join-code migration 2026-09-19. Both migration cards (flag secrets and join code) report their most security-relevant outcomes - ungated tournaments, NEEDS ATTENTION entries, backfills - only into a <pre> that is cleared on the next click (out.textContent = '' at the top of each handler) and written nowhere durable. No Firestore marker, no entry in the Nexus _triage_queue convention. Her point: 'refuse to invent a code' is correct, but the only record of a flagged tournament being a scrollable textarea that vanishes is not a decision-forcing mechanism - and this is the exact shape of the bug TOURN-03 came from, where an invite-only tournament was joinable and nobody knew. Remedy: write flagged outcomes to a queryable location so they survive the click, ideally the existing triage-queue convention rather than a new one. NOT a correctness bug in either migration; a visibility gap in both.
